gaps: AnyDesk lets the other person control your mouse and keyboard; a web page cannot, so LayerLink is view, chat, draw and send files only.
AnyDesk's paid plans add unattended access, remote restart, remote printing and Wake-on-LAN. None of these is possible from a browser.
AnyDesk runs on phones as a sharer; browsers on iOS and Android cannot capture the screen, so LayerLink can only be viewed there.
Each LayerLink viewer is a separate upload from your computer, so it suits a handful of viewers rather than an audience.
